## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改测试清单 `platform-core.json` 里 `platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal` 这一项(rev 5 → 6)。「第二个持有者被 422 拒绝」和「冷启动告警」两条改为用一个不声明 namespace 的包来触发;「按 namespace 各持一份」那条加上 connector。
- 为什么改:connector 已按 namespace 收窄(#33431),所有受管类型现在都按 namespace 持有，旧条目要驱动的「不在列表里的类型」已经不存在,QA 实跑两条判不了分。产品没错，过时的是清单。
- 风险与回滚：只改一份 QA 清单，不动产品、不发布。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` 该项的 acceptance[0] 与 acceptance[3] 的 verify,以及 fixtures.requires 里新增的 qa_e 和改为无 namespace 的 com.qa.addr-d。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, item `platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal` only, revision 5 → 6 with a history row:

- **acceptance[1]** now lists connector with the webhook, the flow and the agent as held per namespace (connector since #33431), and drops "connector alone at this revision". It keeps the instruction to re-read the complement before a run.
- **acceptance[0]** is re-pointed, not retired. Two namespaces never clash any more, but a holder with no namespace still meets every holder (`bareNameHoldersMeet` over `namespacedHoldersMeet`). A new fixture package qa_e (`com.qa.addr-e`, no namespace, connector `qa_conn` only) is installed after qa_a and qa_b, and the clause expects 422 `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` naming `qa_conn`, `com.qa.addr-e` and both holders, with no rename (`bareNameRenameFor` has no prefix to suggest). The reason sentence in that message is #33507's product copy and is marked as not scored here.
- **acceptance[3]** is re-pointed, not retired. `sealBareNameHolders` still reports a pair that meets, so the cold-boot fixture's `com.qa.addr-d` drops its namespace. The fixture otherwise stays as written (the `composeStacks(..., { manifest: 'preserve' })` shape QA run #33853 built and booted). The verify text says the warning names a rename only when the later-registered holder declares a namespace.
- Title, `steps[1]` (the qa_b rebuild becomes the qa_e install), `negative[0]`, `negative[2]`, `variants` and `source` follow.

Why the namespace-less shape and not a same-namespace co-owner: it needs no dependency or object prefix in the fixture, and it is the shape QA measured live (the card's com.qa.addr-e probe).

## Tests

Readings at `origin/main` `895783a1`:

- `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`: `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` (lines 103-122) has 13 members, and every one is in `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (lines 160-178, `connector` last under `#31699 PR 3`). The complement is empty.
- A throwaway `ObjectKernel` probe, using the flow-family pin's boot harness (`packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-flow-family.test.ts`) and **not committed**, run under the verify lock after building the objectql closure:

<details><summary>4 probe cases, plus the flow-family file: 2 files, 94/94 passed, VERDICT command-exit 0</summary>

```text
A  cold boot: com.qa.addr-c (ns qa_c) then com.qa.addr-d (no ns), each connector qa_conn
   → one warning: "Bare-name conflict at boot: a second holder among the installed packages —
     package "com.qa.addr-d" declares the connector "qa_conn", already held by package "com.qa.addr-c". …"
B  CONTROL cold boot: qa_c and qa_d, two namespaces → no warning
C  cold boot: com.qa.addr-d (no ns) then com.qa.addr-c (ns qa_c)
   → one warning, with — rename it to "qa_c_qa_conn" in "com.qa.addr-c"
D  after the seal: qa_a (ns qa_a) 200, qa_b (ns qa_b) 200, qa_e (no ns) refused
   → code NAMESPACE_CONFLICT, status 422, "cannot register 2 names another holder already holds —
     … already held by package "com.qa.addr-a"; … already held by package "com.qa.addr-b". …"
```

</details>

No ablation is owed: the diff is a checklist document (os-dev.md).
